# rhcs_cluster_notification_contacts (Resource)

Manages notification contacts for a ROSA cluster. Notification contacts are OCM account usernames that receive cluster notification emails via the cluster's subscription.

~> **Important:** This resource authoritatively manages the complete set of notification contacts for the cluster's subscription. Contacts added outside of Terraform may be removed during the next `terraform apply`. Destroying this resource removes all notification contacts from the subscription.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rhcs_cluster_notification_contacts" "contacts" {
  cluster_id = "cluster-id-123"
  contacts   = ["ocm-username-1", "ocm-username-2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. After the creation of the resource, it is not possible to update the attribute value.
- `contacts` (Set of String) Set of OCM account usernames to receive cluster notification emails. Values must be OCM usernames (not email addresses). While email addresses are accepted by the API, they are resolved to usernames internally, which will cause persistent plan diffs and may lead to incorrect contact removal on subsequent applies. All contacts must belong to the same Red Hat organization as the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the notification contacts resource.



## Import

Notification contacts can be imported using the cluster ID:

```shell
terraform import rhcs_cluster_notification_contacts.contacts <cluster_id>
```
